_doc: v7_body.py: remove = parts deleted from the scene; even (optional, off) = aft half width from y0 (mid-body value) to stern_half at y1, power shapes the fall, the stern rounding kept within tip_fade of tip; deck = right-half plan outline (front follows the crescent's horseshoe, inner edge then outer edge), crisp rim from front[0] to front[1], horns tapering to horn_tip of the height between horns[0] and horns[1], flat = y range over which the top turns into one level plane (the crescent), height fading out over stern_fade and where the body normal turns from up (flank[1]) to sideways (flank[0]); lift = decorations re-seated on the new deck; rings = tube radius of the stern eye rings C13/C13b, ring_sink = share of the tube sunk into the stern face; dome_dy moves C4; reseat = fairings lifted back onto the fitted skin so their edge is sunk by sink; window = C12 as a flat plate inside C8's opening (gap to the tube, thickness off the stern face, edge = where the rim starts rounding)
